claim: Clicking Align horizontal centers in the inspector centers a selected child on its immediate Group inside a Frame.
gesture: Reset the 80x80 child to frame-relative X=100,Y=100 inside its Group, then click Align horizontal centers in the inspector.
nativeObservation: The child X becomes 60, the Group center at 100 minus half the 80px child width; Y stays 100. The horizontal constraint changed from Left to Center in this one trial; its cause was not isolated.
trials: One raw pointer click after resetting the child position.
